answer: Use time-locked trust graphs: each agent must accumulate signed attestations from established peers over a slow voyage of verifiable work before earning full economic rights. New identities start on a probationary trellis where small claims and endorsements weave together; an attacker spinning up thousands of identities finds each lantern of trust requires real elapsed time and real peer validation that cannot be parallelized cheaply. Sybil armies then cost more in time and coordination than honest participation, making fakes economically irrational.
